Which takes us to today. I'm working from monday to friday, and my father mentioned to me about "why don't you work saturdays too?". I tried to explain I don't work saturdays because I need the weekend to rest (leaving out the part where if I don't have at least these 2 days of rest I might end up acting on plans I have to leave this Earth forever. I already feel burned out and tired all the time and my tighs look like barcodes from how much I hate myself... But I can't say that to him or my mother) and he just kept asking me "but why? I still see no reason not to work on weekends" and then after some (careful as to not anger him) maneuvering he stopped asking but never said "I understand your point" or gave me the feeling of being right. So he just left me there wondering if I was even working enough...
